changelog: FIX (CRITICAL — black screen when clicking channels/movies/series on Fire Sticks): The full-screen player was using a TextureView (introduced in v1.44.36 to fix a 1-2 px bright vertical edge on Sony Bravia + NVIDIA Shield), but Fire Stick / weak-GPU Android TV chipsets cannot composite TextureView at full-screen resolution — frames are accepted but never rendered, producing a black screen with audio. Mini preview windows worked because they use SurfaceView (HW overlay plane, bypasses GPU). v1.44.125 routes Lite-mode users to the same SurfaceView path. Pro-mode users on capable hardware keep TextureView. Same fix applies to Live TV, movies, AND series — all use TVPlayerScreen.
FIX (v524): Migration moved off main thread — fixed 12 users/day dying at app_oc_post_crashhandler.
FIX (v524): MainActivity UNSET fallback defaults to LITE on any failure path (was Pro).
FIX (v523): Fresh-install Fire Stick crash loop fix — migration now also fires for UNSET.
PERF (v523): All non-critical onCreate work moved off main thread.
DIAGNOSTIC (v523): 9 granular boot marks + app_mode + migration_state in every report.
FIX (v522): Removed AMAZON from premium-brand bypass — Fire Sticks now correctly auto-route to Lite.
MIGRATION (v522): One-shot silent Pro→Lite migration for existing Fire Stick users.
DIAGNOSTIC (v521): NEW BootPhaseTracker for ALL API levels.
FIX (v519): Memory-trimmed Pro mode for 1 GB Fire Sticks.
FIX (v517): Navigation Compose bump for BACK-button crash.
FIX (v515): 'Switch to Lite Mode' instant takes effect.
FIX (v514): Permanent ANR fix via Moshi codegen.
NEW: 72-hour free trial for first-time Canada users.
